pairs.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:50 Guide topic content comes from bundled local modules loaded with a static dynamic import, and a search of src/app/guide/[category] and src/app/guide/guide-page found no Accept-Ranges, Content-Range, bytes= range requests or fetch( calls, so these pages never read from a remote store they do not run.

techniques.evidence: src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:50 Content is a local bundled module, so no peer sends a capability header for the read path to branch on.
src/app/guide/[category]/[topic]/page.tsx:3 Category and topic metadata are static repo data, so no capability round trip happens.

pairs.subject: remote-capability-probing
pairs.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:51 The only remote reads are the project's own Supabase synced_messages table (owned store, which falls under optional-dependency-degradation) and a health check of its own orchestrator (the health-checks neighbour); a search of src/components/dashboard found no Accept-Ranges, Content-Range or bytes= range handling, so no remote peer's capabilities are ever probed.

techniques.evidence: src/components/dashboard/views/messages/useMessagesData.ts:51 Whole-row query to the project's own Supabase, not a partial read against a stranger's store.
src/components/dashboard/views/settings/index.tsx:41 This is a liveness check of the team's own orchestrator (the health-checks neighbour), not a multi-row capability report.
src/components/dashboard/views/settings/settings-sections/ModelProvidersCard.tsx:24 The only switch is demo versus live mode, not an operator flag that turns a capability probe off.
